from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

FONT = "Arial"
BLUE = "0000FF"; BLACK = "000000"; GREEN = "008000"; NAVY = "1F3864"
GREYFILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="D9D9D9")
NAVYFILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F3864")
LIGHTFILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="EDEDED")
TEAMFILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E2EFDA")
YELLOW = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFF2CC")
thin = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
BORDER = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
CUR = '$#,##0;($#,##0);"-"'; PCT = '0.0%'; NUM1 = '0.0;(0.0);"-"'; INT = '0'

MONTHS = ["Jul-26","Aug-26","Sep-26","Oct-26","Nov-26","Dec-26",
          "Jan-27","Feb-27","Mar-27","Apr-27","May-27","Jun-27","Jul-27"]
NM = len(MONTHS); COL0 = 2; LASTCOL = COL0 + NM - 1
wb = Workbook()

def title_block(ws, t1, t2):
    ws["A1"] = t1; ws["A1"].font = Font(name=FONT, size=14, bold=True, color="FFFFFF"); ws["A1"].fill = NAVYFILL
    ws["A2"] = t2; ws["A2"].font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, italic=True, color="FFFFFF"); ws["A2"].fill = NAVYFILL
    for c in range(1, 8):
        ws.cell(row=1, column=c).fill = NAVYFILL; ws.cell(row=2, column=c).fill = NAVYFILL

asx = wb.active; asx.title = "Assumptions"; ar = {}
title_block(asx, "The Luxora Collective  |  New-Engine Pro Forma (Draft for Partner Review)",
            "Conservative base case  |  DWY + DFY only  |  Jul 2026 - Jul 2027  |  Projections, not historical")

def sec(ws, r, label):
    for c in range(1,4):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).fill = GREYFILL
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).font = Font(name=FONT, size=11, bold=True, color=NAVY)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=label); return r+1
def add(ws, r, key, label, value, fmt=None, is_input=True, note=""):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=label).font = Font(name=FONT, size=10)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=value)
    c.font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, bold=True, color=(BLUE if is_input else BLACK))
    if fmt: c.number_format = fmt
    c.border = BORDER
    if is_input: c.fill = YELLOW
    if note: ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=note).font = Font(name=FONT, size=9, italic=True, color="808080")
    ar[key] = r; return r+1

row = 4
row = sec(asx, row, "LEAD ENGINE (new marketing partner)")
row = add(asx, row, "leads", "Leads per day (steady-state)", 2, "0.0", note="Vendor promises 3-8/day; base uses 2 as a conservative haircut")
row = add(asx, row, "days", "Selling days per month", 30, "0")
row += 1
row = sec(asx, row, "LEAD RAMP (gradual, 6-month build to full)")
row = add(asx, row, "ramp1", "Month 1 (Jul) - onboarding", 0.25, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "ramp2", "Month 2 (Aug)", 0.40, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "ramp3", "Month 3 (Sep)", 0.55, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "ramp4", "Month 4 (Oct)", 0.70, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "ramp5", "Month 5 (Nov)", 0.85, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "ramp6", "Month 6 onward (full run)", 1.00, PCT)
row += 1
row = sec(asx, row, "CONVERSION")
row = add(asx, row, "show", "Show rate (% of leads, per marketing partner)", 0.70, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "close1", "Close rate - Months 1-3 (closers ramping)", 0.30, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "close2", "Close rate - Months 4-6", 0.40, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "close3", "Close rate - Months 7-13", 0.50, PCT, note="60% goal modeled in the Upside scenario")
row += 1
row = sec(asx, row, "OFFER MIX & PRICING (90-day programs)")
row = add(asx, row, "mix_dwy", "DWY mix (% of deals)", 0.60, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "mix_dfy", "DFY mix (% of deals)", 0.40, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "price_dwy", "DWY price (one-time)", 10000, CUR)
row = add(asx, row, "price_dfy", "DFY price (one-time)", 15000, CUR)
row = add(asx, row, "dfy_mo", "DFY partnership ($/mo)", 2500, CUR)
asx.cell(row=row, column=1, value="DFY partnership start").font = Font(name=FONT, size=10)
nc = asx.cell(row=row, column=2, value="Month +3"); nc.font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, italic=True, color="808080"); nc.border = BORDER
asx.cell(row=row, column=3, value="Begins after the 90-day program completes").font = Font(name=FONT, size=9, italic=True, color="808080")
row += 2
row = sec(asx, row, "SALES COMPENSATION (commission)")
row = add(asx, row, "setter", "Setter commission (% of one-time deal value)", 0.05, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "closer", "Closer commission (% of one-time deal value)", 0.10, PCT)
asx.cell(row=row, column=1, value="Total sales commission (% of one-time)").font = Font(name=FONT, size=10)
tc = asx.cell(row=row, column=2, value=f"=B{ar['setter']}+B{ar['closer']}")
tc.font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, bold=True, color=BLACK); tc.number_format = PCT; tc.border = BORDER
ar["comm_total"] = row; row += 1
row = add(asx, row, "comm_rec", "Commission on recurring partnership (%)", 0.0, PCT, note="Default 0; raise if closers earn residual")
row += 1
row = sec(asx, row, "SALES TEAM RAMP (headcount, capacity & base/draw)")
row = add(asx, row, "setter_cap", "Leads/month one setter can work", 60, INT, note="Drives how many setters are needed")
row = add(asx, row, "closer_cap", "Shown calls/month one closer can run", 40, INT, note="2nd closer is added when shown calls cross this")
row = add(asx, row, "setter_base", "Setter base/draw ($/mo each)", 1500, CUR, note="Added on top of commission; set 0 for pure-commission")
row = add(asx, row, "closer_base", "Closer base/draw ($/mo each)", 2500, CUR, note="If draw is recoverable vs commission, real cost is lower")
row += 1
row = sec(asx, row, "DELIVERY / FULFILLMENT COST")
row = add(asx, row, "del_dwy", "DWY delivery cost (% of price)", 0.30, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "del_dfy", "DFY delivery cost (% of price)", 0.35, PCT)
row = add(asx, row, "del_rec", "DFY recurring delivery cost (% of $/mo)", 0.40, PCT)
row += 1
row = sec(asx, row, "FIXED COST")
row = add(asx, row, "overhead", "Monthly overhead, non-sales (per your figure)", 20000, CUR, note="Assumed to INCLUDE marketing retainer + ad spend - confirm")
row = add(asx, row, "churn", "Monthly DFY logo churn (%)", 0.0, PCT, note="Base assumes none; stress with churn")

asx.column_dimensions["A"].width = 46; asx.column_dimensions["B"].width = 14; asx.column_dimensions["C"].width = 58
asx.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
A = "Assumptions"
def aref(k): return f"{A}!$B${ar[k]}"

def write_engine(ws, base_row, refs, header_label):
    r = base_row
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=header_label).font = Font(name=FONT, size=12, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    for c in range(1, LASTCOL+1): ws.cell(row=r, column=c).fill = NAVYFILL
    r += 1
    rows = {}
    def line(label, key, fill=None, bold=False, indent=False):
        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=("   "+label) if indent else label)
        cell.font = Font(name=FONT, size=9, bold=bold, color=NAVY if bold else BLACK)
        if fill:
            for c in range(1, LASTCOL+1): ws.cell(row=r, column=c).fill = fill
        rows[key] = r; return r
    rr = line("Month", "mlabel", fill=LIGHTFILL, bold=True)
    for i,m in enumerate(MONTHS):
        cc = ws.cell(row=rr, column=COL0+i, value=m)
        cc.font = Font(name=FONT, size=9, bold=True, color="FFFFFF"); cc.fill = NAVYFILL; cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
    r += 1
    rr = line("Month #", "mnum")
    for i in range(NM): ws.cell(row=rr, column=COL0+i, value=i+1).number_format = "0"
    r += 1
    def frow(key, label, fmt, builder, bold=False, fill=None, indent=True):
        nonlocal r
        rr = line(label, key, fill=fill, indent=indent, bold=bold)
        for i in range(NM):
            col = get_column_letter(COL0+i); prevcol = get_column_letter(COL0+i-1) if i>0 else None
            cell = ws.cell(row=rr, column=COL0+i, value=builder(i, col, prevcol, rows))
            cell.number_format = fmt; cell.font = Font(name=FONT, size=9, bold=bold, color=BLACK)
        r += 1; return rr
    def b_ramp(i,c,p,rw): return f"={refs['ramp'+str(min(i+1,6))]}"
    frow("ramp","Lead ramp", PCT, b_ramp)
    frow("ld","Leads / day", NUM1, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={refs['leads']}*{c}{rw['ramp']}")
    frow("lm","Leads / month", '#,##0', lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['ld']}*{refs['days']}")
    frow("sh","Shown leads", NUM1, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['lm']}*{refs['show']}")
    def b_close(i): return refs['close1'] if i<=2 else (refs['close2'] if i<=5 else refs['close3'])
    frow("deals","Deals closed", NUM1, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['sh']}*{b_close(i)}", bold=True)
    # ---- sales team headcount (demand-driven) ----
    frow("setters","Setters needed (headcount)", INT,
         lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=MAX(1,CEILING({c}{rw['lm']}/{refs['setter_cap']},1))", fill=TEAMFILL)
    frow("closers","Closers needed (headcount)", INT,
         lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=MAX(1,CEILING({c}{rw['sh']}/{refs['closer_cap']},1))", fill=TEAMFILL)
    frow("dwy","DWY deals", NUM1, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['deals']}*{refs['mix_dwy']}")
    frow("dfy","DFY deals (new)", NUM1, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['deals']}*{refs['mix_dfy']}")
    frow("ot","One-time revenue", CUR,
         lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['dwy']}*{refs['price_dwy']}+{c}{rw['dfy']}*{refs['price_dfy']}")
    def b_active(i,c,p,rw):
        if i==0: return 0
        term = ""
        if i>=3:
            c3 = get_column_letter(COL0+i-3); term = f"+{c3}{rw['dfy']}"
        return f"={p}{rw['active']}*(1-{refs['churn']}){term}"
    frow("active","Active DFY partnerships (start mo +3)", NUM1, b_active)
    frow("mrr","Recurring revenue (MRR)", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['active']}*{refs['dfy_mo']}")
    frow("trev","Total revenue", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['ot']}+{c}{rw['mrr']}", bold=True, fill=LIGHTFILL)
    frow("comm","Sales commission", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=-({c}{rw['ot']}*{refs['comm_total']}+{c}{rw['mrr']}*{refs['comm_rec']})")
    frow("salesbase","Sales base/draw (setters+closers)", CUR,
         lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=-({c}{rw['setters']}*{refs['setter_base']}+{c}{rw['closers']}*{refs['closer_base']})")
    frow("delot","Delivery cost - one-time", CUR,
         lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=-({c}{rw['dwy']}*{refs['price_dwy']}*{refs['del_dwy']}+{c}{rw['dfy']}*{refs['price_dfy']}*{refs['del_dfy']})")
    frow("delrec","Delivery cost - recurring", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=-{c}{rw['mrr']}*{refs['del_rec']}")
    frow("oh","Overhead (fixed, non-sales)", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=-{refs['overhead']}")
    frow("tc","Total costs", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=SUM({c}{rw['comm']}:{c}{rw['oh']})", bold=True)
    frow("net","Net profit", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['trev']}+{c}{rw['tc']}", bold=True, fill=LIGHTFILL)
    frow("margin","Net margin", PCT, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"=IF({c}{rw['trev']}=0,0,{c}{rw['net']}/{c}{rw['trev']})")
    frow("cum","Cumulative net profit", CUR, lambda i,c,p,rw: f"={c}{rw['net']}" if i==0 else f"={p}{rw['cum']}+{c}{rw['net']}", bold=True)
    return rows

shared_keys = ["leads","days","ramp1","ramp2","ramp3","ramp4","ramp5","ramp6","show","close1","close2","close3",
               "mix_dwy","mix_dfy","price_dwy","price_dfy","dfy_mo","comm_total","comm_rec",
               "setter_cap","closer_cap","setter_base","closer_base",
               "del_dwy","del_dfy","del_rec","overhead","churn"]
base_refs = {k: aref(k) for k in shared_keys}

mo = wb.create_sheet("Monthly Pro Forma")
title_block(mo, "Monthly Pro Forma  |  Conservative Base Case (DWY + DFY)",
            "Sales team scales with volume: base 1 setter + 1 closer, 2nd closer added when shown calls cross capacity. Base/draw + commission both charged.")
mo.freeze_panes = "B5"
brows = write_engine(mo, 4, base_refs, "BASE CASE  -  2 leads/day, 70% show, close ramp to 50%, demand-driven sales team")
mo.column_dimensions["A"].width = 34
for i in range(NM): mo.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(COL0+i)].width = 11
mo.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

sc = wb.create_sheet("Scenarios")
title_block(sc, "Scenario Range  |  Downside / Base / Upside",
            "Volume, show, close and mix vary. Pricing, sales-team capacity/base and cost structure held constant.")
hdr_r = 4
for j,lab in enumerate(["Lever","Base","Downside","Upside"]):
    cc = sc.cell(row=hdr_r, column=1+j, value=lab)
    cc.font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, bold=True, color="FFFFFF"); cc.fill = NAVYFILL; cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
sc_rows = {}
def sline(r, key, label, base_ref_key, down, up, fmt):
    sc.cell(row=r, column=1, value=label).font = Font(name=FONT, size=10)
    b = sc.cell(row=r, column=2, value=f"={A}!$B${ar[base_ref_key]}")
    b.font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, color=GREEN); b.number_format = fmt; b.border = BORDER
    cd = sc.cell(row=r, column=3, value=down); cd.font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, bold=True, color=BLUE); cd.number_format = fmt; cd.fill = YELLOW; cd.border = BORDER
    cu = sc.cell(row=r, column=4, value=up); cu.font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, bold=True, color=BLUE); cu.number_format = fmt; cu.fill = YELLOW; cu.border = BORDER
    sc_rows[key] = r
r = hdr_r+1
sline(r,"leads","Leads per day","leads",1.5,3,"0.0"); r+=1
sline(r,"show","Show rate","show",0.60,0.75,PCT); r+=1
sline(r,"close","Close rate (flat)","close3",0.30,0.60,PCT); r+=1
sline(r,"mix_dwy","DWY mix","mix_dwy",0.70,0.55,PCT); r+=1
sline(r,"mix_dfy","DFY mix","mix_dfy",0.30,0.45,PCT); r+=1

def scen_refs(colletter):
    d = dict(base_refs)
    for k in ["leads","show","mix_dwy","mix_dfy"]:
        d[k] = f"Scenarios!${colletter}${sc_rows[k]}"
    for k in ["close1","close2","close3"]:
        d[k] = f"Scenarios!${colletter}${sc_rows['close']}"
    return d

down_rows = write_engine(sc, r+1, scen_refs("C"), "DOWNSIDE  -  1.5 leads/day, 60% show, 30% close")
up_rows = write_engine(sc, r+1+27, scen_refs("D"), "UPSIDE  -  3 leads/day, 75% show, 60% close")
sc.column_dimensions["A"].width = 34
for col in ["B","C","D"]: sc.column_dimensions[col].width = 13
sc.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

su = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
wb.move_sheet("Summary", -(len(wb.sheetnames)-1))
title_block(su, "The Luxora Collective  |  Pro Forma Summary (Underwriter Submission - Draft)",
            "DWY $10k / DFY $15k + $2,500/mo after 90-day program  |  Demand-driven setter/closer team")
su["A4"] = "Projection window: July 2026 through July 2027 (13 months). Conservative base case."
su["A4"].font = Font(name=FONT, size=10, italic=True)
hr = 6
for j,h in enumerate(["Metric","Downside","Base Case","Upside"]):
    cc = su.cell(row=hr, column=1+j, value=h)
    cc.font = Font(name=FONT, size=11, bold=True, color="FFFFFF"); cc.fill = NAVYFILL; cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

    35	extract-text document.docx
    36	
    37	# Show tracked changes instead of accepting them
    38	pandoc --track-changes=all document.docx -o output.md
    39	
    40	# Raw XML access
    41	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
    42	```
    43	
    44	### Converting to Images
    45	
    46	```bash
    47	python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to pdf document.docx
    48	pdftoppm -jpeg -r 150 document.pdf page
    49	ls page-*.jpg
    50	```
    51	
    52	`pdftoppm` zero-pads the page number to the width of the total page count (so a 12-page PDF produces `page-01.jpg`…`page-12.jpg`, not `page-1.jpg`). Use the `ls` to get the actual filenames before reading them.
    53	
    54	### Accepting Tracked Changes
    55	
    56	To produce a clean document with all tracked changes accepted (requires LibreOffice):
    57	
    58	```bash
    59	python scripts/accept_changes.py input.docx output.docx
    60	```
    61	
    62	---
    63	
    64	## Creating New Documents
    65	
    66	Generate .docx files with JavaScript, then validate. Install: `npm install -g docx`
    67	
    68	### Setup
    69	```javascript
    70	const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell, ImageRun,
    71	        Header, Footer, AlignmentType, PageOrientation, LevelFormat, ExternalHyperlink,
    72	        InternalHyperlink, Bookmark, FootnoteReferenceRun, PositionalTab,
    73	        PositionalTabAlignment, PositionalTabRelativeTo, PositionalTabLeader,
    74	        TabStopType, TabStopPosition, Column, SectionType,
    75	        TableOfContents, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
    76	        VerticalAlign, PageNumber, PageBreak } = require('docx');
    77	
    78	const doc = new Document({ sections: [{ children: [/* content */] }] });
    79	Packer.toBuffer(doc).then(buffer => fs.writeFileSync("doc.docx", buffer));
    80	```
    81	
    82	### Validation
    83	After creating the file, validate it. If validation fails, unpack, fix the XML, and repack.
    84	```bash
    85	python scripts/office/validate.py doc.docx
    86	```
    87	
    88	### Page Size
    89	
    90	```javascript
    91	// CRITICAL: docx-js defaults to A4, not US Letter
    92	// Always set page size explicitly for consistent results
    93	sections: [{
    94	  properties: {
    95	    page: {
    96	      size: {
    97	        width: 12240,   // 8.5 inches in DXA
    98	        height: 15840   // 11 inches in DXA
    99	      },
   100	      margin: { top: 1440, right: 1440, bottom: 1440, left: 1440 } // 1 inch margins
   101	    }
   102	  },
   103	  children: [/* content */]
   104	}]
   105	```
   106	
   107	**Common page sizes (DXA units, 1440 DXA = 1 inch):**
   108	
   109	| Paper | Width | Height | Content Width (1" margins) |
   110	|-------|-------|--------|---------------------------|
   111	| US Letter | 12,240 | 15,840 | 9,360 |
   112	| A4 (default) | 11,906 | 16,838 | 9,026 |
   113	
   114	**Landscape orientation:** docx-js swaps width/height internally, so pass portrait dimensions and let it handle the swap:
   115	```javascript
   116	size: {
   117	  width: 12240,   // Pass SHORT edge as width
   118	  height: 15840,  // Pass LONG edge as height
   119	  orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE  // docx-js swaps them in the XML
   120	},
   121	// Content width = 15840 - left margin - right margin (uses the long edge)
   122	```
   123	
   124	### Styles (Override Built-in Headings)
   125	
   126	Use Arial as the default font (universally supported). Keep titles black for readability.
   127	
   128	```javascript
   129	const doc = new Document({
   130	  styles: {
   131	    default: { document: { run: { font: "Arial", size: 24 } } }, // 12pt default
   132	    paragraphStyles: [
   133	      // IMPORTANT: Use exact IDs to override built-in styles
   134	      { id: "Heading1", name: "Heading 1", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   135	        run: { size: 32, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   136	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 240, after: 240 }, outlineLevel: 0 } }, // outlineLevel required for TOC
   137	      { id: "Heading2", name: "Heading 2", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   138	        run: { size: 28, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   139	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 180, after: 180 }, outlineLevel: 1 } },
   140	    ]
   141	  },
   142	  sections: [{
   143	    children: [
   144	      new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, children: [new TextRun("Title")] }),
   145	    ]
   146	  }]
   147	});
   148	```
   149	
   150	### Lists (NEVER use unicode bullets)
   151	
   152	```javascript
   153	// ❌ WRONG - never manually insert bullet characters
   154	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("• Item")] })  // BAD
   155	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("\u2022 Item")] })  // BAD
   156	
   157	// ✅ CORRECT - use numbering config with LevelFormat.BULLET
   158	const doc = new Document({
   159	  numbering: {
   160	    config: [
   161	      { reference: "bullets",
   162	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.BULLET, text: "•", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   163	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   164	      { reference: "numbers",
   165	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.DECIMAL, text: "%1.", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   166	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   167	    ]
   168	  },
   169	  sections: [{
   170	    children: [
   171	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "bullets", level: 0 },
   172	        children: [new TextRun("Bullet item")] }),
   173	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "numbers", level: 0 },
   174	        children: [new TextRun("Numbered item")] }),
   175	    ]
   176	  }]
   177	});
   178	
   179	// ⚠️ Each reference creates INDEPENDENT numbering
   180	// Same reference = continues (1,2,3 then 4,5,6)
   181	// Different reference = restarts (1,2,3 then 1,2,3)
   182	```
   183	
   184	### Tables
   185	
   186	**CRITICAL: Tables need dual widths** - set both `columnWidths` on the table AND `width` on each cell. Without both, tables render incorrectly on some platforms.
   187	
   188	```javascript
   189	// CRITICAL: Always set table width for consistent rendering
   190	// CRITICAL: Use ShadingType.CLEAR (not SOLID) to prevent black backgrounds
   191	const border = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "CCCCCC" };
   192	const borders = { top: border, bottom: border, left: border, right: border };
   193	
   194	new Table({
   195	  width: { size: 9360, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Always use DXA (percentages break in Google Docs)
   196	  columnWidths: [4680, 4680], // Must sum to table width (DXA: 1440 = 1 inch)
   197	  rows: [
   198	    new TableRow({
   199	      children: [
   200	        new TableCell({
   201	          borders,
   202	          width: { size: 4680, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Also set on each cell
   203	          shading: { fill: "D5E8F0", type: ShadingType.CLEAR }, // CLEAR not SOLID
   204	          margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }, // Cell padding (internal, not added to width)
   205	          children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("Cell")] })]
   206	        })
   207	      ]
   208	    })
   209	  ]
   210	})
	< truncated lines 211-388 >
   389	- **Landscape: pass portrait dimensions** - docx-js swaps width/height internally; pass short edge as `width`, long edge as `height`, and set `orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE`
   390	- **Never use `\n`** - use separate Paragraph elements
   391	- **Never use unicode bullets** - use `LevelFormat.BULLET` with numbering config
   392	- **PageBreak must be in Paragraph** - standalone creates invalid XML
   393	- **ImageRun requires `type`** - always specify png/jpg/etc
   394	- **Always set table `width` with DXA** - never use `WidthType.PERCENTAGE` (breaks in Google Docs)
   395	- **Tables need dual widths** - `columnWidths` array AND cell `width`, both must match
   396	- **Table width = sum of columnWidths** - for DXA, ensure they add up exactly
   397	- **Always add cell margins** - use `margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }` for readable padding
   398	- **Use `ShadingType.CLEAR`** - never SOLID for table shading
   399	- **Never use tables as dividers/rules** - cells have minimum height and render as empty boxes (including in headers/footers); use `border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "2E75B6", space: 1 } }` on a Paragraph instead. For two-column footers, use tab stops (see Tab Stops section), not tables
   400	- **TOC requires HeadingLevel only** - no custom styles on heading paragraphs
   401	- **Override built-in styles** - use exact IDs: "Heading1", "Heading2", etc.
   402	- **Include `outlineLevel`** - required for TOC (0 for H1, 1 for H2, etc.)
   403	
   404	---
   405	
   406	## Editing Existing Documents
   407	
   408	**Follow all 3 steps in order.**
   409	
   410	### Step 1: Unpack
   411	```bash
   412	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
   413	```
   414	Extracts XML, pretty-prints, merges adjacent runs, and converts smart quotes to XML entities (`“` etc.) so they survive editing. Use `--merge-runs false` to skip run merging.
   415	
   416	### Step 2: Edit XML
   417	
   418	Edit files in `unpacked/word/`. See XML Reference below for patterns.
   419	
   420	**Use "Claude" as the author** for tracked changes and comments, unless the user explicitly requests use of a different name.
   421	
   422	**Use the Edit tool directly for string replacement. Do not write Python scripts.** Scripts introduce unnecessary complexity. The Edit tool shows exactly what is being replaced.
   423	
   424	**CRITICAL: Use smart quotes for new content.** When adding text with apostrophes or quotes, use XML entities to produce smart quotes:
   425	```xml
   426	<!-- Use these entities for professional typography -->
   427	<w:t>Here’s a quote: “Hello”</w:t>
   428	```
   429	| Entity | Character |
   430	|--------|-----------|
   431	| `‘` | ‘ (left single) |
   432	| `’` | ’ (right single / apostrophe) |
   433	| `“` | “ (left double) |
   434	| `”` | ” (right double) |
   435	
   436	**Adding comments:** Use `comment.py` to handle boilerplate across multiple XML files (text must be pre-escaped XML):
   437	```bash
   438	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Comment text with & and ’"
   439	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 1 "Reply text" --parent 0  # reply to comment 0
   440	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Text" --author "Custom Author"  # custom author name
   441	```
   442	Then add markers to document.xml (see Comments in XML Reference).
   443	
   444	### Step 3: Pack
   445	```bash
   446	python scripts/office/pack.py unpacked/ output.docx --original document.docx
   447	```
   448	Validates with auto-repair, condenses XML, and creates DOCX. Use `--validate false` to skip.
   449	
   450	**Auto-repair will fix:**
   451	- `durableId` >= 0x7FFFFFFF (regenerates valid ID)
   452	- Missing `xml:space="preserve"` on `<w:t>` with whitespace
   453	
   454	**Auto-repair won't fix:**
   455	- Malformed XML, invalid element nesting, missing relationships, schema violations
   456	
   457	### Common Pitfalls
   458	
   459	- **Replace entire `<w:r>` elements**: When adding tracked changes, replace the whole `<w:r>...</w:r>` block with `<w:del>...<w:ins>...` as siblings. Don't inject tracked change tags inside a run.
   460	- **Preserve `<w:rPr>` formatting**: Copy the original run's `<w:rPr>` block into your tracked change runs to maintain bold, font size, etc.
   461	
   462	---
   463	
   464	## XML Reference
   465	
   466	### Schema Compliance
   467	
   468	- **Element order in `<w:pPr>`**: `<w:pStyle>`, `<w:numPr>`, `<w:spacing>`, `<w:ind>`, `<w:jc>`, `<w:rPr>` last
   469	- **Whitespace**: Add `xml:space="preserve"` to `<w:t>` with leading/trailing spaces
   470	- **RSIDs**: Must be 8-digit hex (e.g., `00AB1234`)
   471	
   472	### Tracked Changes
   473	
   474	**Insertion:**
   475	```xml
   476	<w:ins w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   477	  <w:r><w:t>inserted text</w:t></w:r>
   478	</w:ins>
   479	```
   480	
   481	**Deletion:**
   482	```xml
   483	<w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   484	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   485	</w:del>
   486	```
   487	
   488	**Inside `<w:del>`**: Use `<w:delText>` instead of `<w:t>`, and `<w:delInstrText>` instead of `<w:instrText>`.
   489	
   490	**Minimal edits** - only mark what changes:
   491	```xml
   492	<!-- Change "30 days" to "60 days" -->
   493	<w:r><w:t>The term is </w:t></w:r>
   494	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   495	  <w:r><w:delText>30</w:delText></w:r>
   496	</w:del>
   497	<w:ins w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   498	  <w:r><w:t>60</w:t></w:r>
   499	</w:ins>
   500	<w:r><w:t> days.</w:t></w:r>
   501	```
   502	
   503	**Deleting entire paragraphs/list items** - when removing ALL content from a paragraph, also mark the paragraph mark as deleted so it merges with the next paragraph. Add `<w:del/>` inside `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`:
   504	```xml
   505	<w:p>
   506	  <w:pPr>
   507	    <w:numPr>...</w:numPr>  <!-- list numbering if present -->
   508	    <w:rPr>
   509	      <w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"/>
   510	    </w:rPr>
   511	  </w:pPr>
   512	  <w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   513	    <w:r><w:delText>Entire paragraph content being deleted...</w:delText></w:r>
   514	  </w:del>
   515	</w:p>
   516	```
   517	Without the `<w:del/>` in `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`, accepting changes leaves an empty paragraph/list item.
   518	
   519	**Rejecting another author's insertion** - nest deletion inside their insertion:
   520	```xml
   521	<w:ins w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   522	  <w:del w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   523	    <w:r><w:delText>their inserted text</w:delText></w:r>
   524	  </w:del>
   525	</w:ins>
   526	```
   527	
   528	**Restoring another author's deletion** - add insertion after (don't modify their deletion):
   529	```xml
   530	<w:del w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   531	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   532	</w:del>
   533	<w:ins w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   534	  <w:r><w:t>deleted text</w:t></w:r>
   535	</w:ins>
   536	```
   537	
   538	### Comments
   539	
   540	After running `comment.py` (see Step 2), add markers to document.xml. For replies, use `--parent` flag and nest markers inside the parent's.
   541	
   542	**CRITICAL: `<w:commentRangeStart>` and `<w:commentRangeEnd>` are siblings of `<w:r>`, never inside `<w:r>`.**
   543	
   544	```xml
   545	<!-- Comment markers are direct children of w:p, never inside w:r -->
   546	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   547	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   548	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted</w:delText></w:r>
   549	</w:del>
   550	<w:r><w:t> more text</w:t></w:r>
   551	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   552	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   553	
   554	<!-- Comment 0 with reply 1 nested inside -->
   555	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   556	  <w:commentRangeStart w:id="1"/>
   557	  <w:r><w:t>text</w:t></w:r>
   558	  <w:commentRangeEnd w:id="1"/>
   559	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   560	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   561	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="1"/></w:r>
   562	```
   563	
   564	### Images
   565	
   566	1. Add image file to `word/media/`
   567	2. Add relationship to `word/_rels/document.xml.rels`:
   568	```xml
   569	<Relationship Id="rId5" Type=".../image" Target="media/image1.png"/>
   570	```
   571	3. Add content type to `[Content_Types].xml`:
   572	```xml
   573	<Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/>
   574	```
   575	4. Reference in document.xml:
   576	```xml
   577	<w:drawing>
   578	  <wp:inline>
   579	    <wp:extent cx="914400" cy="914400"/>  <!-- EMUs: 914400 = 1 inch -->
   580	    <a:graphic>
   581	      <a:graphicData uri=".../picture">
   582	        <pic:pic>
   583	          <pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId5"/></pic:blipFill>
   584	        </pic:pic>
   585	      </a:graphicData>
   586	    </a:graphic>
   587	  </wp:inline>
   588	</w:drawing>
   589	```
   590	
   591	---
   592	
   593	## Dependencies
   594	
   595	- **pandoc**: Text extraction
   596	- **docx**: `npm install -g docx` (new documents)
   597	- **LibreOffice**: PDF conversion (auto-configured for sandboxed environments via `scripts/office/soffice.py`)
   598	- **Poppler**: `pdftoppm` for images

Here is what I put for each, pulled from the model:

Ticket Size: $10,000 to $15,000 one-time (DWY $10k, DFY $15k), plus $2,500/month partnership on DFY clients after their 90-day program. Blended about $12,000.

Current Monthly Revenue: ~$20,000/month now, with the new lead engine launching and revenue projected to scale. This is the one field you need to verify, since the model is a forward projection and does not actually hold a "current" number.

Closer Compensation: $2,500/month base or draw, plus 10% commission on the one-time value ($1,000 per DWY, $1,500 per DFY). OTE roughly $12,000 to $16,000/month, about $150K to $190K/year at full ramp, lower in the first 60 to 90 days.

Experience Requirements: 2+ years high-ticket consultative closing by phone or video, proven at $10K-plus offers, comfortable selling to business owners (aesthetics a plus), CRM and follow-up discipline, holds price without discounting, self-managed remote.

Time Commitment: Full-time, roughly 2 to 3 booked calls per day at capacity (~40/month per closer) plus follow-up and pipeline work, standard business hours with time-zone flexibility.

Two things to decide before you send it:

1. The current-revenue line is the weak spot. I wrote it soft on purpose. If your real current run rate is higher or lower than $20K, change that one line, because a recruiter will repeat it to candidates and it sets expectations.

2. The OTE I quoted assumes the closer earns commission only on the one-time value, not the recurring $2,500/month, which matches how the model pays. If you actually want closers earning a residual on the partnership fee, their OTE goes up and I should revise both the brief and the pro forma to match.
